Since 2009 · Oslo

Our story

Closetoskin began with a passion for beautiful things that are natural and long-lasting.

We are a group of friends who studied together in London some 30 years ago. We grew up by the Caribbean sea, where our greatest joy was floating in the water. That feeling of silk against the body is what makes us feel at home, and it is the feeling we wanted to bring to everyday clothing.

We founded Closetoskin in 2009 for people who want to feel comfortable and look modern: urban, busy and discerning, yet unwilling to compromise on comfort or value.

Natural materials, by choice

We care about nature and want to do our share. That is why our collections are built on natural materials: wool, silk, cotton and cashmere. Fibres that breathe, regulate temperature and feel good against the skin.

What sets us apart

  • Natural materials of good quality. Every garment lists its exact composition.
  • Simple design. Modern basics you'll reach for again and again.
  • Superior craftsmanship and fit. From fine-knit underwear to hand-woven Italian leather.

It's about you

It's about feeling wonderful in whatever you're wearing and whatever you're doing. It's about luxury, quality, simplicity and style, and about giving a gift that's remembered.
